name: Skill trial sandbox
description: S3: the envelope a drafted Skill's examples are tried under. A Skill is instructions + schemas — no code runs, nothing is containerised; the profile is the limits the trial obeys: no network, no credentials (the trial offers the model no tool), ≤ 60 s for the whole trial, ≤ 2 MiB of answers, one trial at a time, data up to confidential. A Project layer may only narrow it.
